notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Hello all Rainbow Hero Fans,

I have just resolved most of the issues reported so far:
- Steam log on is no longer required to play the game
- fixed problems with some achievements not being awarded sometimes

Have fun and thank you all for your support.

tags.feature: - Steam log on is no longer required to play the game

tags.bug: - fixed problems with some achievements not being awarded sometimes
